touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Welbourn qualifies as a local detour through Castle Hill ringwork and Welbourn Castle. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Welbourn: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Welbourn offers Castle Hill ringwork, Welbourn Castle, CHURCH OF ST CHAD within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Castle Hill ringwork
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Castle Hill ringwork and Welbourn Castle, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
